One central articulated brass swivel supports a delicate crescent-shaped antenna, with one milky violet glowing glass bulb at the top crescent tip. Soft lilac-brown leather shoulder straps. Housing width 40cm, height 34cm, depth 14cm; antenna extends 30cm above housing, lies in parallel plane to decorated face. Decorative face square to camera with exact symmetrical speaker. Leather shoulder harness attaches to four brass anchors on the hidden flat contact side; only small realistic side portions of harness visible. Antenna root at top center. Design should have its own clear silhouette and tasteful functional detail. Input image is MATERIAL STYLE reference only; do not include any creature or copy its body shape.
